dialogues.speaker: Pooria
dialogues.text: I live near the market. I'm a craftsman who works with gold.

dialogues.speaker: Pooria
dialogues.text: I've been doing this my whole life, and I created all sorts of gold pieces, big and small, of various values, but I like making jewelry for newlyweds the most.

dialogues.speaker: Pooria
dialogues.text: When a young couple holds the newly-made gold jewelry, their faces shine brighter than gold. I feel happy watching such moments.

dialogues.speaker: Pooria
dialogues.text: It's just that I'm a little short-sighted lately, so I can't see well when drawing... Do you think I should take on an apprentice?
